reasoning: This question asks whether US commercial and industrial (C&I) loans will increase between March 15 and March 22, 2026 - a one-week period. The TOTCI series from the Federal Reserve tracks total C&I loans and is updated weekly on Wednesdays. Over short weekly periods, C&I loans show high volatility but a slight upward trend historically. Given the seasonal adjustment and normal business lending patterns, there's roughly a 50-50 chance of week-to-week increases. However, considering long-term growth trends in the economy and lending, a slight positive bias exists. Without specific economic shocks anticipated for that week, I estimate a modest probability above 50%.
